validity.recommendation: P2315 is a real, heavily-documented, independently-corroborated operating pipeline -- the first major trunk gas pipeline out of Western Siberia (commissioned 4 Feb 1966), and is NOT a duplicate of P2357/P5745 (SRTO-Ural I/II). All three PIDs share the same general Igrim/Berezovsky-to-Urals geographic corridor and P2315's nangs.org source explicitly frames Igrim-Serov as a precursor/part of the 'СРТО-Урал' transport corridor -- but SRTO-Ural I/II are distinct, later (1974/1983), larger-diameter (1220mm/1420mm) pipelines built by a distinct ungg.org-documented construction program, so this is standard GOIT corridor-sharing, not a duplicate entity. No existence, duplicate, or misclassification concern. TWO SPEC CAVEATS for a future pass: (1) Diameter's third multi-value entry, 1200mm, could not be corroborated by any of the six sources gathered this session (1000mm and 1020mm are each independently sourced) -- not necessarily wrong, but unconfirmed; (2) Capacity=10.00 bcm/y rests only on an untraceable WebSearch-summarized claim this session (see Capacity [ref], UNRESOLVED) -- the two gazprom.ru pages most likely to state this figure are both access failures (one times out with no Wayback snapshot, the other's Wayback capture does not itself state a capacity in the sections read). Neither caveat is proposed as a value change -- both are flagged for further sourcing, not disputed.

Existence/duplicate/classification all amply corroborated -- impossible to be a phantom or misclassified entry given the density of independent, dated, multi-decade documentation naming this exact pipeline. Owner=Gazprom PJSC 100% resolved via a Wayback capture of Gazprom's own subsidiary disclosure page (live origin is a *.gazprom.ru timeout, an access failure per standing rule, not a dead link). One naming-convention nuance resolved (not filed as an error): GEM's 'Berezovskoye, Igrimskoe fields' = the historical 'Berezovskaya (Igrimskaya) group' comprising Punginskoye + Severo-Igrimskoye + Yuzhno-Igrimskoye per both nangs.org and admigrim.ru.
